correctness.rationale: Walsh convolution diagonalizes K on the 2^(n-1) antipodal classes with even character degree, eigenvalue binomial sum and multiplicity C(n,2k). Fractional-cosine representation gives lambda_2k=2^(n-1)c_p(-1)^(k+1) I_(k,n-2k). For odd residual exponent m, pair consecutive pi-intervals: F(u)>0 on (0,pi/2), antisymmetry and decreasing positive h_j(u) force I>0, even m nonnegative. Thus zero nullity for 0<p<2; exact weights are forced by K invertibility after testing against all sign vectors. p=2 expansion leaves degrees 0,2 only. Independent numerical binomial spectra at n=4,7,10 and p=1,1.5,1.8 showed predicted signs; examined check_rademacher_inertia.py. Restricts quadrature nodes to original Boolean sign cube.
